scope: CPU-only descriptive E0; no causal effect or invariant-arithmetic claim

C8.launcher_conversion: lut[8].chunk_max_mee is table[254] as FP16; launcher converts this stored half to float
C8.method: Explicit NumPy float32 intermediates, host expression left-to-right multiplication, 127 sequential float32 power updates; each representative converted to float16 round-to-nearest-even. No Python-double recurrence oracle.
C8.uncertainty: Not exported from the loaded host LUT. Compiler evaluation/reassociation equivalence is unverified and error bound unknown. Estimate only; cannot prove CUDA raw-scale invariance or justify scientific early stop.

fraction_formula: float64 descriptive max_abs / estimated FP16 C8; binary32(1e-7) / (base_scale + binary32(1e-7)); not actual CUDA intermediate arithmetic
quantile_rule: Ordinary quantiles: NumPy linear interpolation. Energy-weighted quantiles: smallest observed value whose inclusive cumulative energy reaches p; p=0 smallest positive-weight value.

inputs.stored_scale_product_note: FP64 product of actual packet UINT8 group scale and BF16 super-unit; not the unquantized raw scale or a CPU reproduction of fast-math decoding.
